newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady, tone firm.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady, tone firm.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen steady on Thursday, with Wall Street's overnight rise and a generally peaceful election campaign seen boosting sentiment on big-caps, brokers said.
"Wall Street's rise overnight is likely to boost sentiment on big-caps, particularly on the part of the foreign players," one broker said.
The broker said so far there were only few reports of violence in relation with the general election campaign, but they were not politically significant.
"As long as there are no reports of significant troubles, sentiment should remain firm," one broker said.
The market was likely to focus on shipping firm Berlian on talk that the firm had possibly secured large loans for expansion.
Property firm Elang Realty and newly-listed Multidana were also likely to remain active on speculative reasons, brokers said.
On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index rose 4.82 points to close at 652.05 points.
